blocks.title: Off-Grid-Site
blocks.sub: Instructions, information and sample sites for the off grid site device.

cols.html: Off-Grid-Site is a device that stores HTML websites and serves them on the go. It generates its own SSID and mobile hotspot, so once a user connects, whatever HTML code you add is hosted.
I wanted a devise that could serve a webpage to other people, mainly as a fun prank while on the bus or in a coffee shop. Fairly childish, I know!

cols.text: What can it be used for?

cols.html: It reall is down to your imagination! You can relatively host anything and serve it to anyone in the a local area.

cols.text: Who can see the hosted pages?

cols.html:
Anyone locally who joins the network will be directed automatically to your hosted website. 

What does local mean?
• Indoors (with walls and floors): Around 10 to 20 meters (30 to 65 feet) before signal degradation or dropped connections occur.
• Outdoors (standard / reliable connection): Up to 30 to 100 meters (100 to 330 feet) with a standard onboard PCB antenna.
